stories.headline: You Know Who Really Hates AI? Insurance Claims Adjusters
stories.dek: Of the Glassdoor reviews from claims adjusters that mentioned AI, a staggering 98 percent were negative. “AI is just a tool,” one person tells WIRED. “It should never be given the keys.”

stories.headline: Musk’s faster path to more gas turbines comes with pollution problem
stories.dek: Elon Musk says a secretive new SpaceX foundry will let him cast his own turbine blades and get gas power online 18 months faster than anyone else — but it's a bet on a fuel source that's already triggering lawsuits and health studies everywhere his (and others') turbines have gone in.
